name: Fortune Favors
source:
Join Felix and Ashton, as they stumble through their freshmen year of college together. This enemies-to-lovers story is sure to pull on some heartstrings, so sit back and enjoy the ride!

[From [url=https://blaykestr8.itch.io/fortune-favors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随菲利克斯与阿什顿的脚步，看两人如何跌跌撞撞地一同度过大学一年级时光。这段欢喜冤家变恋人的故事定能拨动你的心弦，尽管放松坐好，享受这段旅程吧！

[摘自[url=https://blaykestr8.itch.io/fortune-favors]itch.io[/url]]
